overview: The Medford City Council met to consider municipal appointments, budget transfers, housing eviction concerns, and several policy resolutions. The Council approved a $45,000 budget transfer for parking department staffing, voted to establish a Board of Election Commissioners, and referred various ordinance drafts and policy updates to subcommittees.

items.title: Claim Settlement: Scarlett Bartlett
items.summary: The Council approved a $5,000 property damage claim settlement for Scarlett Bartlett related to sewer damage.

items.title: License Commission Appointment: Robert Delafano
items.summary: The Council approved the appointment of Robert Delafano to the License Commission for a term expiring June 1, 2028.

items.title: Beautification Committee Ordinance Review
items.summary: The Council referred a draft ordinance establishing a Beautification Committee to the Rules and Ordinances Subcommittee.

items.title: Recreation Department Teen Programming
items.summary: The Council commended the Recreation Department for its teen programming and referred future programming and facility plans to subcommittee.

items.title: Creation of Board of Election Commissioners
items.summary: The Council voted to accept M.G.L. Chapter 51, Section 16A to establish a Board of Election Commissioners.

items.title: Residential Property Tax Exemption Overview
items.summary: The Council referred a resolution requesting an overview of the statutory residential exemption from the Chief Assessor to a Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Climate Action and Adaptation Plan Implementation
items.summary: The Council referred a resolution regarding the execution of the Climate Action and Adaptation Plan to the Subcommittee on Climate, Sustainability, and Transportation.

items.title: Diversity in Municipal Hiring Update
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution requesting the city administration present an update on plans and practices for increasing municipal hiring diversity.

items.title: Budget Transfer for Parking Department Staffing
items.summary: The Council approved a $45,000 transfer from police personnel to parking personnel to fund additional staffing, while also approving a motion to invite the Parking Director back for a future progress update.

items.title: Eviction Notices at 22-26 Bradley Road
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution as amended requesting city intervention, constituent outreach, and legal resources regarding mass tenancy terminations at 22-26 Bradley Road.

items.title: Committee Report: Snow Removal Ordinance
items.summary: The Council approved the Public Works and Utilities Subcommittee report recommending a draft snow removal ordinance for review in a Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Public Participation: North Street Paving
items.summary: Resident Shelby Fioravanti inquired about repairs for severe potholes on North Street, prompting discussion on DPW emergency patching and road resurfacing backlogs.

items.title: Meeting Records
items.summary: The Council tabled approval of the meeting records from March 22, 2022.
